text: Hello, good morning. I am calling about the order we discussed last week.
Good morning. Yes, of course, I remember the conversation.
We agreed on twelve thousand for the whole batch. Is that still correct?
Actually the costs went up, so it is eighteen thousand now.
That is a very large increase. When exactly will you send the documents?
I will send the documents on Friday without fail, I promise.
And the contract itself? You said you would put it in writing.
Let us not worry about the paperwork right now. You have to decide today.
I would still like the contract before I decide anything.
